src: 老師自編例句練習題（非大考原題），答案都是本題庫詞彙題考過的字

accent.s: It isn't important to speak English with a perfect ______ as long as people understand what you're saying.
accent.z: 只要別人聽得懂你在說什麼，說英文的口音標不標準並不重要。

access.s: All public school children must have equal ______ to a high-quality education, regardless of where they live.
access.z: 不論住在哪裡，所有公立學校的孩子都應該有同等的機會接受良好的教育。

access.s: The MRT gives people easy ______ to different parts of Taipei without having to deal with traffic jams and exhaust fumes.
access.z: 捷運讓人可以輕鬆到達台北各地，不必面對塞車和廢氣。

accidentally.s: Mike ______ knocked over a coffee cup, and it shattered into pieces on the floor.
accidentally.z: Mike 不小心打翻了咖啡杯，杯子掉在地上摔得粉碎。

accordingly.s: Before going on a tour, you should check the weather and dress ______.
accordingly.z: 出門旅遊前，應該先查天氣，再依天氣穿衣服。

acquaint.s: Though everyone is ______ with Mrs. Lennox and admires her, almost no one knows that she has a little girl.
acquaint.z: 雖然大家都認識也欣賞 Lennox 太太，卻幾乎沒有人知道她有一個小女兒。

adapted.s: Bottlenose dolphins are very flexible in their behavior and are well ______ to their habitat.
adapted.z: 瓶鼻海豚的行為很有彈性，很能適應牠們的棲息環境。

adjust.s: Kids who are just starting kindergarten may feel homesick because they haven't ______ to a new routine yet.
adjust.z: 剛上幼兒園的孩子可能會想家，因為他們還沒適應新的作息。

adopt.s: The one-child policy wasn't ______ by China until 1979.
adopt.z: 中國直到 1979 年才採行一胎化政策。

advantage.s: Good custom-made software can help a company gain a considerable ______ over its competitors.
advantage.z: 一套好的客製化軟體能讓公司在競爭中取得相當大的優勢。

advantage.s: Lisa is here to answer our questions about applying to colleges. We should take ______ of that.
advantage.z: Lisa 來這裡回答我們申請大學的問題，我們應該好好利用這個機會。

aggressive.s: Shelly's dog is very ______. It tries to bite anyone it doesn't know.
aggressive.z: Shelly 的狗很兇，見到不認識的人就想咬。

amazingly.s: A car hit the boy, and the driver drove off. ______, he had only a scrape on his knee.
amazingly.z: 一輛車撞了那個男孩，駕駛直接開走了。令人驚訝的是，男孩只有膝蓋擦傷。

ambiguous.s: The speaker's closing words were deliberately ______, leaving the listeners with more questions than answers.
ambiguous.z: 講者的結語刻意說得模稜兩可，讓聽眾帶著更多疑問離開。

analyze.s: Keeping a diary has many benefits. For example, you can ______ what has happened and find the best way to avoid making the same mistake next time.
analyze.z: 寫日記有很多好處，例如可以分析發生過的事，找出最好的辦法，下次避免犯同樣的錯。

anxiously.s: Have you ever waited ______ for the results of an important exam?
anxiously.z: 你有沒有焦急地等過重要考試的成績？

apologized.s: I have written to Emma and ______ many times, but she won't forgive me.
apologized.z: 我寫了好幾次信給 Emma 道歉，她還是不肯原諒我。

apology.s: Come on, it isn't difficult to make an ______ to others as long as you're sincere.
apology.z: 拜託，只要有誠意，向別人道歉並不難。

appeal.s: Many warehouse stores ______ to shoppers whose only concern is price.
appeal.z: 很多量販店吸引的是只在乎價格的顧客。

applauding.s: Nationally and locally, communities are ______ businesses that take the initiative to reduce pollution.
applauding.z: 從全國到地方，各地社區都在為主動減少污染的企業喝采。

applauding.s: Taipei's public transportation should be ______. It's so convenient that you don't need a car to get anywhere.
applauding.z: 台北的大眾運輸值得稱讚，方便到你去哪裡都不需要開車。

approaching.s: As the train ______ the station, I could see two familiar figures on the platform.
approaching.z: 火車駛近車站時，我看到月台上有兩個熟悉的身影。

artificial.s: The hotel built an ______ beach with sand brought in by truck.
artificial.z: 這家飯店用卡車運來沙子，蓋了一座人工沙灘。

assemble.s: After hours of work, Tanya has finally ______ enough information to begin writing her thesis.
assemble.z: 忙了好幾個小時，Tanya 終於蒐集到足夠的資料，可以開始寫論文了。

attached.s: Ashley has ______ herself to Amy and follows her everywhere she goes.
attached.z: Ashley 一直黏著 Amy，Amy 走到哪裡她就跟到哪裡。

available.s: The new phone will be ______ in all major electronics stores starting next Friday.
available.z: 這款新手機下週五起在各大電器行都買得到。

awkward.s: Hanna is at an ______ age. She is old enough to have adult problems but too young to know how to handle them.
awkward.z: Hanna 正處在尷尬的年紀，大到會遇上大人的問題，卻又小到不知道怎麼處理。

barely.s: One of the smallest babies ever to survive was born 16 weeks early and weighed ______ half a pound at birth.
barely.z: 有一個早產 16 週的嬰兒，出生時體重才半磅左右，是存活下來的嬰兒中最小的之一。

benefit.s: Green tea is said to provide a wide variety of health ______, but many of them have not been proven by scientific evidence.
benefit.z: 據說綠茶對健康有很多好處，但其中不少並沒有科學證據支持。

boasting.s: The stadium ______ a seating capacity of more than 80,000.
boasting.z: 這座體育場號稱可以容納八萬多名觀眾。

brilliant.s: George was not a ______ student, but he had an earnest desire to learn.
brilliant.z: George 不是特別聰明的學生，但他非常想學。

browse.s: About twenty percent of employees ______ the Internet for personal reasons while at work.
browse.z: 大約兩成的員工上班時會為了私事上網瀏覽。

campaign.s: The clothing company is known for its bold advertising ______, which often shocks the public.
campaign.z: 這家服飾公司以大膽的廣告宣傳活動出名，常常讓大眾大吃一驚。

capable.s: Stadium planners want to build a multi-use park ______ of hosting a variety of events.
capable.z: 體育場的規劃人員想蓋一座能舉辦各種活動的多功能園區。

capacity.s: The new stadium has a seating ______ of 50,000.
capacity.z: 新體育場可以容納五萬名觀眾。

caused.s: A woman is recovering in the hospital after crashing her car. The police are trying to find out what ______ her to lose control of the car.
caused.z: 一名女子撞車後正在醫院休養，警方正在調查她為什麼會失控。

clumsy.s: Amanda tried to make a nice meal, but she was so ______ in the kitchen that she broke two plates.
clumsy.z: Amanda 想做一頓好菜，但她在廚房笨手笨腳，打破了兩個盤子。

collapsed.s: Rescuers are searching for survivors after a bridge ______ during the storm.
collapsed.z: 一座橋在暴風雨中倒塌，救難人員正在搜尋生還者。

commitment.s: Many Americans have made a lasting ______ to protecting the environment.
commitment.z: 很多美國人承諾長期投入環境保護。

committed.s: When two or more people ______ a crime, the sentence may depend on the role each person played.
committed.z: 兩人以上共同犯罪時，刑罰輕重可能要看每個人扮演的角色。

common.s: The scooter is the most ______ form of transportation for people in Taiwan.
common.z: 機車是台灣最常見的交通工具。

common.s: Although Sam and Max are twins, they have nothing in ______.
common.z: Sam 和 Max 雖然是雙胞胎，卻一點共同點也沒有。

companion.s: When I travel, I find my tablet a wonderful ______: small, useful, and able to do many things.
companion.z: 旅行時，我覺得平板是很棒的旅伴，輕巧、實用，又有很多功能。

competitive.s: The restaurant industry is very ______. Customers expect great food, excellent service, and a pleasant dining experience.
competitive.z: 餐飲業競爭非常激烈，顧客期待美味的餐點、很好的服務和愉快的用餐經驗。

competitive.s: It's no fun to play with Leo; he's too ______.
competitive.z: 跟 Leo 玩一點都不好玩，他好勝心太強了。

complaint.s: When we made a ______ to the manager about the poor service, he did not take us seriously at all.
complaint.z: 我們向經理投訴服務很差，他卻完全不當一回事。

complicated.s: Technology is constantly getting more ______. Not being able to figure out how your smartphone works can be quite frustrating.
complicated.z: 科技越來越複雜，搞不懂自己的手機怎麼用，真的很讓人沮喪。

compliment.s: The boss thought that Gilly deserved a ______ for a job well done.
compliment.z: 老闆認為 Gilly 工作做得好，值得稱讚。

conceal.s: When Rita unexpectedly saw the boy she liked, she blushed and tried to ______ her embarrassment with a smile.
conceal.z: Rita 突然看到喜歡的男生，臉紅了起來，想用微笑掩飾自己的尷尬。

concrete.s: The chairperson was glad that some fairly ______ proposals were put forward during the meeting.
concrete.z: 主席很高興會議上有人提出一些相當具體的提案。

concrete.s: The small town lets its residents live in an area with lots of grass, instead of a ______ jungle.
concrete.z: 這個小鎮讓居民住在有大片草地的地方，而不是水泥叢林。

conducted.s: A study ______ by university researchers suggests that teenagers need more sleep than adults.
conducted.z: 大學研究人員做的一項研究指出，青少年需要的睡眠比成人多。

confirmed.s: Bird flu has been ______ on a turkey farm in the south of the country.
confirmed.z: 該國南部一處火雞養殖場確定出現禽流感。

conflicts.s: The most effective way to resolve a ______ is to talk it over.
conflicts.z: 解決衝突最有效的方法就是把事情談開。

connection.s: Parents should set time aside to build a close ______ with their kids.
connection.z: 父母應該撥出時間，和孩子建立親密的關係。

connection.s: As long as your flight is on time, you should have no problem making your ______.
connection.z: 只要你的班機準時，轉機應該沒問題。

conquered.s: After finally ______ her fear of heights, Denise jumped off the rock into the water.
conquered.z: Denise 終於克服懼高，從岩石上跳進水裡。

consciousness.s: After drinking too much, a man lost ______ on his way home. When he woke up, he found himself in a police station.
consciousness.z: 一名男子喝了太多酒，在回家路上失去意識，醒來發現自己在警察局。

conservation.s: Worried about rising fuel use, the government has sped up its energy ______ plans, including a tax on gasoline.
conservation.z: 政府擔心燃料用量增加，加快推動節能計畫，其中包括課徵汽油稅。

consistently.s: Thanks to her warm personality, the TV host has been ______ ranked among the most popular in the country for ten years.
consistently.z: 這位電視主持人個性親切，十年來一直名列全國最受歡迎的主持人。

constantly.s: Once Eddie discovered that Fran was thin-skinned, he couldn't resist teasing her ______.
constantly.z: Eddie 一發現 Fran 臉皮很薄、開不起玩笑，就忍不住老是捉弄她。

construction.s: When the typhoon hit, a building that was under ______ collapsed.
construction.z: 颱風來襲時，一棟施工中的建築倒塌了。

construction.s: In addition to the MRT lines now in service, several more are under ______.
construction.z: 除了現在通車的捷運路線，還有好幾條正在興建。

consults.s: Before taking herbal medicine, ______ your doctor about the proper way to use it.
consults.z: 吃草藥之前，先請教醫師正確的用法。

consumption.s: Eating at night often means snacking and too much calorie ______.
consumption.z: 晚上吃東西常常就是吃零食，攝取太多熱量。

contact.s: Octopuses are famously shy. They usually avoid ______ not only with humans but with other creatures, including other octopuses.
contact.z: 章魚出了名的害羞，通常不只避免和人類接觸，連其他生物、甚至同類也一樣。

contains.s: Avoid peeling fruits and vegetables, since the skin ______ a lot of fiber.
contains.z: 蔬果盡量不要削皮，因為皮含有大量纖維。

contrary.s: ______ to popular Western myths, bats do not attack people, and they are not blind.
contrary.z: 和西方常見的迷思相反，蝙蝠不會攻擊人，也不是瞎子。

courtesy.s: To me, ______ is the act of being considerate of others, polite and caring.
courtesy.z: 對我來說，禮貌就是體貼別人、有禮又關心人。

crashed.s: The plane ______ and burst into flames after taking off from the wrong runway.
crashed.z: 那架飛機從錯誤的跑道起飛後墜毀，隨即起火燃燒。

decline.s: One major reason Taiwan's population is aging so quickly is that its birthrate has ______ faster than in many other countries.
decline.z: 台灣人口老化這麼快，一個主要原因是出生率下降得比許多國家都快。

deliberate.s: Investigators believe the fire was not an accident but a ______ attempt to destroy evidence.
deliberate.z: 調查人員認為那場火不是意外，而是有人故意要銷毀證據。

delivered.s: In the U.S., many children start making their own money at a very young age, by ______ newspapers or doing household chores for others.
delivered.z: 在美國，很多孩子很小就開始自己賺錢，例如送報紙或幫別人做家事。

delivered.s: The following article is adapted from a speech Prof. White ______ at the university earlier this month.
delivered.z: 下面這篇文章改寫自 White 教授本月稍早在大學發表的演講。

departure.s: Once the plane is in the air, the screen will show the actual ______ time and the estimated arrival time.
departure.z: 飛機起飛後，螢幕上會顯示實際起飛時間和預計抵達時間。

deserve.s: Does the coach ______ all the credit for the team's success?
deserve.z: 球隊的成功，全都該歸功於教練嗎？

destroy.s: A forest fire ______ thousands of acres of wildlife habitat near the town.
destroy.z: 一場森林大火燒毀了小鎮附近數千英畝的野生動物棲地。

devoted.s: As a new immigrant, Mike has ______ a lot of his time to studying Chinese over the past few years.
devoted.z: Mike 是新移民，這幾年花了很多時間學中文。

diagnosed.s: My uncle has been ______ with diabetes, so the whole family is trying to eat less sugar.
diagnosed.z: 醫生診斷出我叔叔有糖尿病，所以全家人都在努力少吃糖。

diligent.s: You used to be such a ______ student, and now look at what you've become—a good-for-nothing. You should be more motivated.
diligent.z: 你以前是那麼用功的學生，看看你現在變成什麼樣子，一事無成。你應該更有幹勁一點。

disaster.s: Last year, many people lost their lives in natural ______. Thousands of towns were destroyed by floods, typhoons, and earthquakes.
disaster.z: 去年有很多人死於天然災害，數千個城鎮毀於洪水、颱風和地震。

discouraged.s: Rising gas prices have ______ people from driving.
discouraged.z: 油價上漲讓大家不想開車。

discrimination.s: An employer must be careful not to show any sign of age ______ when dealing with employees.
discrimination.z: 雇主對待員工時要小心，不能表現出任何年齡歧視。

disguised.s: After getting a bad haircut, Amy tried to ______ it by wearing a cap.
disguised.z: Amy 剪壞了頭髮，想戴帽子遮掩。

dismissed.s: I dreamed of taking a trip to Europe but ______ the thought because of my tight budget.
dismissed.z: 我夢想去歐洲旅行，但因為預算很緊，只好打消這個念頭。

disposable.s: To cut down on waste, bring your own cup and avoid ______ containers as much as possible.
disposable.z: 為了減少垃圾，自己帶杯子，盡量不用拋棄式容器。

distinctly.s: The two presidential candidates have ______ different personalities, so the country may go in different directions depending on who is elected.
distinctly.z: 兩位總統候選人的個性截然不同，這個國家會走向哪裡，要看誰當選。

distribute.s: Songwriters find it hard to stop people from downloading and ______ copyrighted music.
distribute.z: 詞曲創作者很難阻止別人下載和散布有版權的音樂。

distribute.s: Some experts believe the earth could support 7 to 12 billion people at a decent standard of living by ______ land and food more fairly.
distribute.z: 有些專家認為，只要更公平地分配土地和糧食，地球可以讓七十億到一百二十億人過還不錯的生活。

distribution.s: "The rich get richer and the poor get poorer" is a familiar saying about the unequal ______ of wealth.
distribution.z: 「富者越富，貧者越貧」這句話說的是財富分配不均。

disturbed.s: Leo was trying to concentrate on his assignment but couldn't because of the loud music downstairs. His neighbor has been ______ him for days.
disturbed.z: Leo 想專心寫作業，卻因為樓下音樂太吵沒辦法。鄰居已經吵了他好幾天。

drought.s: During the ______, only a limited amount of water was given to each household.
drought.z: 乾旱期間，每戶只能分到有限的水。

drought.s: After three years without rain, severe ______ is making life very difficult in parts of East Africa.
drought.z: 東非部分地區三年沒下雨，嚴重的乾旱讓當地人的生活非常困難。

edge.s: With so many cafés in Taipei, a coffee shop has to set fair prices to gain a competitive ______.
edge.z: 台北的咖啡店這麼多，一家店要訂出合理的價格才能取得競爭優勢。

efficiently.s: Using your appliances ______ can help you save energy around the house and lower your electricity bills all year round.
efficiently.z: 有效率地使用家電可以節省家裡的能源，一整年都能降低電費。

engaged.s: It is important to keep safety in mind at all times while ______ in water sports.
engaged.z: 從事水上活動時，一定要隨時注意安全。

enormously.s: Without Taiwan's National Health Insurance, medical treatment would be ______ expensive.
enormously.z: 如果沒有全民健保，看病會貴得多。

enthusiastic.s: Not everyone is ______ about social media.
enthusiastic.z: 不是每個人都熱衷於社群媒體。

equally.s: Success doesn't depend only on what you do. What you don't do is ______ important.
equally.z: 成功不只看你做了什麼，你沒做什麼也一樣重要。

estimate.s: According to the latest ______, about 5,000 people attended the concert.
estimate.z: 根據最新的估計，大約有五千人到場聽演唱會。

estimated.s: The funeral of Princess Diana in London on 6 September 1997 drew an ______ three million mourners.
estimated.z: 1997 年 9 月 6 日黛安娜王妃在倫敦舉行葬禮，估計有三百萬人到場哀悼。

estimated.s: It is ______ that the city's population will reach three million by 2040.
estimated.z: 據估計，這座城市的人口在 2040 年以前會達到三百萬。

estimated.s: By 2050, the world's population is ______ to reach nearly 10 billion.
estimated.z: 據估計，到 2050 年全球人口將接近一百億。

evaluates.s: The government plans to develop an index to ______ how happy people are.
evaluates.z: 政府打算建立一套指標，評估人民的幸福程度。

evident.s: Laura lost the contest. Her disappointment was ______ on her face, but she took it with good humor.
evident.z: Laura 比賽輸了，臉上明顯看得出失望，但她還是笑笑地面對。

exception.s: Minding your manners is a good rule to follow at any age, time and place, and being courteous on a bus is no ______.
exception.z: 注意禮貌在任何年紀、時間、地點都是好規矩，在公車上也不例外。

exception.s: Everyone thinks they're smarter than everyone else, and I'm no ______.
exception.z: 每個人都覺得自己比別人聰明，我也不例外。

excluded.s: At this mall, promotional discounts ______ sale or clearance items.
excluded.z: 在這家購物中心，促銷折扣不適用於特價品或出清品。

exclusively.s: Admission to the course is reserved ______ for those who have never studied Spanish.
exclusively.z: 這門課只開放給從來沒學過西班牙文的人。

exclusively.s: My grandfather said that the study was ______ for his own use, and no one else was allowed in.
exclusively.z: 爺爺說書房只給他自己用，其他人都不准進去。

expand.s: Thanks to strong exports, the country's economy is likely to ______ more quickly than expected this year.
expand.z: 由於出口強勁，這個國家今年的經濟成長可能比預期還快。

expanded.s: The restaurant has a cozy atmosphere. Better yet, it has recently ______ its menu to include breakfast.
expanded.z: 這家餐廳氣氛溫馨，更棒的是，最近菜單還加了早餐。

explore.s: Children just can't help ______. A whole new world is at their fingertips, and they want to know more about it.
explore.z: 孩子就是忍不住到處探索。一個全新的世界就在眼前，他們想知道更多。

expressive.s: My cat is very ______. You can tell when she is mad, sad, happy, or tired.
expressive.z: 我的貓很會表達情緒，她生氣、難過、開心或累了，你都看得出來。

extended.s: Architects in Mexico City once proposed a skyscraper shaped like an upside-down pyramid that would ______ 65 stories underground.
extended.z: 墨西哥城的建築師曾經提出一座倒金字塔形的摩天大樓，往地下延伸 65 層。

extensively.s: Extremely hard and nearly indestructible, diamonds are used ______ in industry to cut other hard materials.
extensively.z: 鑽石非常堅硬、幾乎不會損壞，在工業上廣泛用來切割其他堅硬的材料。

extremely.s: Living in a big city can be ______ expensive, so if you want to cut down on living expenses, it may be time to consider moving to a small town.
extremely.z: 住在大城市可能非常花錢，如果想減少生活開銷，也許該考慮搬到小鎮。

factors.s: Vancouver was once ranked the world's most livable city, but ______ such as traffic jams caused it to drop in the ranking.
factors.z: 溫哥華曾經名列全球最宜居的城市，但塞車等因素讓排名下滑。

fairly.s: Renting a car is a convenient and ______ economical way of getting around.
fairly.z: 租車是方便又相當省錢的交通方式。

fascinated.s: Some people find the series boring, but many others are ______ by the plot and love the books and movies.
fascinated.z: 有些人覺得這個系列很無聊，但也有很多人深深著迷於劇情，非常喜歡書和電影。

favorably.s: While some people view crows ______, others consider them a nuisance.
favorably.z: 有些人對烏鴉有好感，有些人卻覺得烏鴉很討人厭。

feature.s: An exhibition ______ works by the French painter Jean-François Millet drew large numbers of visitors.
feature.z: 一場展出法國畫家米勒作品的展覽吸引了大批參觀者。

financial.s: The company has been facing ______ losses because of growing competition from online stores.
financial.z: 因為網路商店的競爭越來越激烈，這家公司一直面臨財務虧損。

financial.s: If you are having ______ problems, it is important to act now before those problems get worse.
financial.z: 如果你遇到財務問題，最好趁問題惡化之前馬上處理。

financial.s: Old-age pensions provide ______ assistance to residents aged 65 or older.
financial.z: 老人年金為六十五歲以上的居民提供經濟上的協助。

flock.s: Medical tourists now ______ to Seoul for plastic surgery.
flock.z: 現在有很多醫療觀光客湧向首爾做整形手術。

formation.s: Every year on January 26, India celebrates Republic Day to mark the ______ of the Indian Republic.
formation.z: 每年 1 月 26 日，印度都會慶祝共和國日，紀念印度共和國成立。

fortune.s: If you plan to make a ______ by raising ostriches for their meat, you might want to think again.
fortune.z: 如果你打算靠養鴕鳥賣肉發大財，最好再想一想。

fortune.s: Linda went to Longshan Temple simply to have her ______ told.
fortune.z: Linda 去龍山寺只是為了算命。

frequently.s: My uncle always buys gas at the same station, because it gives gifts to regular customers who ______ fill up there.
frequently.z: 我叔叔都固定在同一家加油站加油，因為那家會送禮物給常來加油的老顧客。

generosity.s: My grandmother is one of those people whose ______ shows in everything she does; she is always giving to others.
generosity.z: 我外婆就是那種處處展現慷慨的人，總是在為別人付出。

gradually.s: The effects of noise on hearing are often underestimated because the damage takes place so ______.
gradually.z: 很多人低估了噪音對聽力的影響，因為傷害是慢慢累積的。

greed.s: In 2011, protesters took to the streets of New York City to protest the ______ and corruption of Wall Street.
greed.z: 2011 年，抗議者走上紐約街頭，抗議華爾街的貪婪與腐敗。

guilty.s: The jury found the police officer ______ of taking bribes to turn a blind eye to drug dealing.
guilty.z: 陪審團認定那名警察收賄、對販毒視而不見，罪名成立。

headline.s: The story of how a young man saved a boy's life hit the ______ in the local newspapers.
headline.z: 一名年輕人救了小男孩的英勇事蹟登上地方報紙的頭條。

hesitate.s: Many pet owners don't ______ to spend more on natural pet food, but does it really help the environment?
hesitate.z: 很多飼主毫不猶豫多花錢買天然寵物食品，但這真的對環境比較好嗎？

highlight.s: One goal of World AIDS Day is to ______ ways to prevent new infections.
highlight.z: 世界愛滋病日的目標之一，是讓大家注意預防新感染的方法。

identify.s: Researchers have ______ a new genetic mechanism that controls the body's fat-building process.
identify.z: 研究人員發現了一種控制人體製造脂肪的新基因機制。

identify.s: Police officers and postal workers wear uniforms because it is important that they be easily ______.
identify.z: 警察和郵差都穿制服，因為讓人一眼就認出他們很重要。

impact.s: A study shows that eating canned food instead of fresh food may have a bigger ______ on health than people thought.
impact.z: 一項研究顯示，吃罐頭食品而不吃新鮮食物，對健康的影響可能比大家想的還大。

impress.s: Whether you want to make Valentine's Day special for your loved one or just want to ______ someone new, it's easy to feel overwhelmed by the occasion.
impress.z: 不管你是想讓另一半過一個特別的情人節，還是想讓新認識的人留下好印象，這個節日都很容易讓人壓力很大。

inappropriate.s: ______ dress and language can get you into trouble at work.
inappropriate.z: 穿著和言語不得體，可能讓你在職場惹上麻煩。

incident.s: A student was hurt in a fight at school, but the principal didn't report the ______ to the police.
incident.z: 一名學生在學校打架受傷，校長卻沒有把這件事通報警方。

influential.s: Celebrities are very ______. When one of them recommends a product, its sales often go up.
influential.z: 名人很有影響力，只要其中一位推薦某項產品，銷量往往就會上升。

influential.s: Children may admire movie stars, athletes, singers, and models, but their most ______ role models are still their parents.
influential.z: 孩子可能崇拜電影明星、運動員、歌手或模特兒，但對他們最有影響力的榜樣還是父母。

informative.s: This is a very ______ program. It gives you a lot of basic knowledge about green building.
informative.z: 這個課程內容很充實，讓你學到很多綠建築的基礎知識。

initiated.s: Even though he was a little shy, Ian ______ a conversation with a pretty girl on the bus.
initiated.z: Ian 雖然有點害羞，還是在公車上主動和一個漂亮的女生聊天。

innocent.s: We know for sure that Tanya looks ______, but she could be "a wolf in sheep's clothing."
innocent.z: Tanya 看起來確實天真無邪，但她可能是披著羊皮的狼。

inspiration.s: The merchant's rags-to-riches story is an ______ to everyone trying to succeed in business.
inspiration.z: 這位商人白手起家的故事，鼓舞了每一個想在商場上成功的人。

instructions.s: Be sure to read the ______ before clicking on the download links!
instructions.z: 點下載連結之前，一定要先看說明！

intention.s: Elsa said she joined the club to make friends, but her real ______ was to meet the boy she liked.
intention.z: Elsa 說她參加社團是為了交朋友，其實真正的目的是想認識她喜歡的男生。

interaction.s: When the keepers were not around, cameras recorded the pandas' ______ with each other.
interaction.z: 保育員不在的時候，攝影機會記錄貓熊之間的互動。

intimate.s: An ______ friend is someone you can share your deepest secrets with, without worrying that they will tell everyone.
intimate.z: 知心朋友就是你可以把最深的祕密告訴他，也不用擔心他到處說出去的人。

invade.s: Ants ______ our kitchen every summer, so we keep all our food in sealed boxes.
invade.z: 每年夏天螞蟻都會入侵我們的廚房，所以食物都放在密封盒裡。

invisible.s: Do you know how to write an ______ message that only appears in water?
invisible.z: 你知道怎麼寫一則碰到水才會顯現的隱形訊息嗎？

isolated.s: Because most management decisions were made in Tokyo, employees in the company's branch offices felt ______ from decision making.
isolated.z: 大部分的管理決策都在東京做成，分公司的員工覺得自己和決策隔絕了。

keen.s: Online sales of electronics are booming, and price competition is ______.
keen.z: 網路上的電子產品賣得很好，價格競爭也很激烈。

lasting.s: Even though the earthquake ______ only 55 seconds, the damage was beyond belief.
lasting.z: 那場地震雖然只持續了 55 秒，造成的破壞卻大得驚人。

launch.s: It has become increasingly popular to ______ magazines for successful television shows.
launch.z: 熱門電視節目推出同名雜誌，越來越常見。

launch.s: Despite the tough business environment, the company hopes to stay profitable by ______ competitive new products.
launch.z: 儘管景氣不好，這家公司希望靠推出有競爭力的新產品來維持獲利。

likely.s: Students who sleep well are more ______ to do well on exams.
likely.z: 睡得好的學生比較有可能考得好。

location.s: The best thing about the hotel is its ______. You'll be able to find everything you're looking for within walking distance.
location.z: 這家飯店最好的地方就是地點，你要找的東西走路都到得了。

manageable.s: If your back pain is no longer ______ with rest and stretching, you should see a doctor.
manageable.z: 如果背痛已經沒辦法靠休息和伸展控制，就應該去看醫生。

mature.s: How can I convince my parents that I am ______ enough to get my ears pierced at 13?
mature.z: 我要怎麼說服爸媽，我已經夠成熟，可以在 13 歲去穿耳洞？

miracle.s: It's a ______ that everyone survived when a truck crashed into a car full of children.
miracle.z: 一輛卡車撞上一輛載滿孩子的車，所有人都活了下來，真是奇蹟。

mutual.s: If Pat and I are both friends with Jay, then Jay is our ______ friend.
mutual.z: 如果 Pat 和我都是 Jay 的朋友，Jay 就是我們共同的朋友。

notoriously.s: Airline food is ______ bad; many travelers joke about it.
notoriously.z: 飛機餐出了名的難吃，很多旅客都拿它開玩笑。

obediently.s: The well-behaved puppy ______ followed its owner around like a shadow.
obediently.z: 那隻乖巧的小狗乖乖地跟在主人身邊，像影子一樣。

objections.s: Sometimes powerful people become so arrogant that they believe they are always right and that those with ______ are wrong.
objections.z: 有時候，有權力的人會變得非常傲慢，認為自己永遠是對的，提出反對意見的人都是錯的。

objective.s: Mr. Wang finds it difficult to remain ______ where his son is concerned.
objective.z: 只要事情和兒子有關，王先生就很難保持客觀。

objectively.s: It's never easy to look at all things ______ and not take sides.
objectively.z: 要客觀看待所有事情、不選邊站，從來都不容易。

observe.s: Though Thanksgiving is a major American holiday, people in Taiwan don't ______ it.
observe.z: 感恩節雖然是美國的重要節日，台灣人卻不過這個節。

occasionally.s: People who follow a mostly vegetarian diet but eat meat ______ are called flexitarians.
occasionally.z: 以蔬食為主、偶爾吃肉的人，稱為彈性素食者。

offensive.s: The potentially ______ material should be removed from Leo's paper before he submits it to the professor.
offensive.z: Leo 交報告給教授之前，應該刪掉可能冒犯人的內容。

opinion.s: The project seems excellent, but local ______ is against it.
opinion.z: 這個計畫看起來很好，但當地民意反對。

originally.s: ______, we were going to Italy, but then we booked a holiday in Greece.
originally.z: 我們原本要去義大利，後來卻訂了希臘的行程。

outbreak.s: Although no ______ of disease have been reported so far, polluted flood water can spread illnesses such as cholera.
outbreak.z: 雖然目前還沒有傳出疫情，受污染的洪水仍可能傳播霍亂之類的疾病。

overlooked.s: A red-eyed tree frog is easily ______ during the day because it usually rests on the underside of a leaf.
overlooked.z: 紅眼樹蛙白天很容易讓人忽略，因為牠通常躲在葉子背面休息。

particularly.s: If you've been to Toronto, you'll know there's no shortage of skyscrapers, ______ in the downtown area.
particularly.z: 如果你去過多倫多，就知道那裡摩天大樓很多，尤其是在市中心。

particularly.s: Cat cafés are popular in many places, ______ in Japan and Korea.
particularly.z: 貓咪咖啡館在很多地方都很受歡迎，尤其是日本和韓國。

passive.s: Although the health risks a ______ smoker faces are much lower than those of an active smoker, secondhand smoke still contains many poisonous chemicals.
passive.z: 雖然吸二手菸的人面對的健康風險比吸菸者本人低得多，二手菸還是含有很多有毒的化學物質。

permit.s: To climb Yushan, you will need to apply for a ______ from Yushan National Park first.
permit.z: 要爬玉山，得先向玉山國家公園申請許可。

personally.s: I'm sorry that I can't be of any help. You will have to see the principal ______ as soon as possible.
personally.z: 很抱歉我幫不上忙，你得盡快親自去見校長。

polish.s: Kids should read widely both in and out of school to ______ their basic reading skills.
polish.z: 孩子應該在校內外大量閱讀，磨練基本的閱讀能力。

portable.s: My grandfather's ______ radio goes everywhere with him, even to the park.
portable.z: 爺爺那台隨身收音機走到哪裡都帶著，連去公園也不例外。

pose.s: Drinking too much fruit juice can ______ a risk to your health because it contains a lot of sugar.
pose.z: 果汁喝太多可能危害健康，因為裡面含有很多糖。

pose.s: Compared with the peace and quiet of the countryside, city life can be dangerous. Pollution, crime, and constant traffic all ______ threats to human health and safety.
pose.z: 和鄉下的寧靜相比，城市生活可能很危險。污染、犯罪和不斷的車流都威脅著人的健康和安全。

potential.s: With the number of ______ students decreasing, recruiting students has become a battle for many universities.
potential.z: 潛在的學生越來越少，招生對很多大學來說就像打仗。

potential.s: What should I wear to make a good impression on a ______ employer?
potential.z: 去見可能的雇主，要穿什麼才能留下好印象？

potentially.s: All drugs are ______ dangerous; even common painkillers can cause serious side effects.
potentially.z: 所有藥物都有潛在的危險，連常見的止痛藥也可能有嚴重的副作用。

precisely.s: Scientists still disagree about ______ when the first humans arrived in the Americas.
precisely.z: 科學家對人類究竟是什麼時候第一次來到美洲，到現在還有不同看法。

preserved.s: Forrest Gump (1994) was chosen to be ______ in the U.S. National Film Registry because of its lasting importance to American culture.
preserved.z: 電影《阿甘正傳》（1994）對美國文化有深遠的意義，獲選列入美國國家影片登記表永久保存。

pretended.s: The pickpocket took a man's wallet and ______ nothing had happened.
pretended.z: 扒手偷了一個男人的皮夾，還裝作什麼事都沒發生。

previously.s: The poet's original manuscript, which was ______ believed lost, was sold for an unexpectedly high price in 2007.
previously.z: 這位詩人的原稿先前一度以為已經遺失，2007 年卻以出乎意料的高價賣出。

privilege.s: Tanya was given the rare ______ of using the general manager's office. This made her colleagues very jealous.
privilege.z: Tanya 獲得少有的特權，可以使用總經理的辦公室，讓同事非常嫉妒。

productive.s: Many people think that working all the time means being ______, but a tired brain gets less done than you think.
productive.z: 很多人以為一直工作就是有生產力，但疲累的大腦能完成的事比你想的少。

protests.s: Tens of thousands of people joined the ______ to demand cleaner air.
protests.z: 數萬人參加抗議活動，要求改善空氣品質。

radically.s: Josh's casual approach to work is ______ different from Simon's serious approach.
radically.z: Josh 對工作很隨性，和 Simon 的認真截然不同。

recalled.s: The carmaker has ______ thousands of vehicles because they may have faulty air bags.
recalled.z: 這家車廠因為安全氣囊可能有瑕疵，召回了數千輛車。

recession.s: In spite of the economic ______, electricity demand continues to grow in many Asian countries.
recession.z: 儘管經濟不景氣，許多亞洲國家的用電需求還是持續成長。

recognize.s: Bill lost so much weight that even his best friends didn't ______ him at first glance.
recognize.z: Bill 瘦了好多，連他最好的朋友都沒有一眼認出他。

recognized.s: In 2011, Guinness World Records ______ an 18-year-old Indian girl as the world's shortest woman.
recognized.z: 2011 年，金氏世界紀錄認證一名 18 歲的印度女孩是全世界最矮的女性。

released.s: After the injured birds recovered, the zoo ______ them back into the wild.
released.z: 受傷的鳥兒康復後，動物園把牠們放回野外。

remedy.s: A hot towel is a simple home ______ for sore shoulders.
remedy.z: 熱毛巾是舒緩肩膀痠痛的簡單居家療法。

represents.s: Lisa's wedding ring ______ her husband's love and commitment to her.
represents.z: Lisa 的婚戒代表丈夫對她的愛與承諾。

represents.s: In one survey, the oyster omelet was chosen as the snack that best ______ Taiwan, followed by bubble tea.
represents.z: 在一項調查中，蚵仔煎獲選為最能代表台灣的小吃，第二名是珍珠奶茶。

reservation.s: Hotels in the city cut their room prices by half because ______ fell far short of expectations.
reservation.z: 這座城市的飯店房價砍了一半，因為訂房數遠不如預期。

reserve.s: You can ______ a table for this Saturday night by phone or online.
reserve.z: 你可以打電話或上網訂這週六晚上的位子。

response.s: Young sunflowers turn their heads in ______ to the movement of the sun.
response.z: 年輕的向日葵會隨著太陽移動轉動花盤。

retreat.s: In a stressful world, a spa can serve as a special ______ for rest and healing.
retreat.z: 在充滿壓力的世界裡，水療館可以是一處讓人休息療癒的去處。

routine.s: My grandmother takes a walk at six every morning. It is one of her ______ activities.
routine.z: 我奶奶每天早上六點散步，這是她每天固定的活動之一。

scratch.s: While parking, Leo accidentally ______ his friend's car.
scratch.z: Leo 停車時不小心刮到朋友的車。

shortly.s: The badly injured woman died ______ after she was taken to the hospital, in spite of intensive care.
shortly.z: 那名重傷的女子雖然接受了加護治療，送醫後不久還是過世了。

shrink.s: Because of global warming, many glaciers around the world are ______ year by year.
shrink.z: 因為全球暖化，世界各地很多冰河都一年比一年小。

sincere.s: The shop owner is ______ and honest. He never tries to cheat his customers.
sincere.z: 店老闆為人真誠老實，從來不想占顧客便宜。

spread.s: Stray animals cause problems in many parts of Taiwan. They hunt wildlife, multiply too quickly, cause car accidents, and even ______ diseases.
spread.z: 流浪動物在台灣很多地方造成問題：捕食野生動物、數量增加太快、引發車禍，甚至傳播疾病。

stingy.s: So ______ is the father that he gives his kids very little allowance.
stingy.z: 那位父親非常小氣，給孩子的零用錢少得可憐。

struck.s: A strong earthquake ______ western Mexico, shaking buildings even in the capital.
struck.z: 一場強烈地震襲擊墨西哥西部，連首都的建築物都在搖晃。

sufficient.s: To prevent constipation, eat ______ fiber, exercise regularly, and drink plenty of water.
sufficient.z: 想預防便祕，就要攝取足夠的纖維、規律運動，還要多喝水。

superior.s: Some fans believe that their favorite brand's products are perfect and ______ to all others.
superior.z: 有些品牌的粉絲認為，自己喜愛的品牌產品完美無瑕，比其他產品都好。

suspected.s: When Rita gave me a box of candy, I ______ it was a trick; sure enough, a toy snake popped out when I opened the lid.
suspected.z: Rita 送我一盒糖果時，我懷疑有詐；果然，我一打開蓋子，就跳出一條玩具蛇。

sustains.s: Emergency room staff did everything possible to ______ the patient's life.
sustains.z: 急診室的醫護人員盡了一切努力維持病人的生命。

symptoms.s: Parkinson's disease cannot be diagnosed with a blood test. It takes a trained eye, because other disorders share some of its ______.
symptoms.z: 帕金森氏症沒辦法靠驗血診斷，要靠經驗豐富的醫師判斷，因為其他疾病也有一些相同的症狀。

temporarily.s: In 2011, the government of the Maldives ______ banned hotels from dumping their garbage on Thilafushi, an artificial island used almost entirely as a garbage dump.
temporarily.z: 2011 年，馬爾地夫政府暫時禁止飯店把垃圾倒在提拉富西島；這座人工島幾乎整座都是垃圾場。

tendency.s: Despite the growing ______ to eat out, most people still have some of their meals at home.
tendency.z: 雖然越來越多人外食，大多數人還是有幾餐在家吃。

tolerant.s: A remarkably patient father, Mr. Tsai was very ______ of his daughter's love of loud music.
tolerant.z: 蔡先生是個非常有耐心的父親，很能包容女兒愛聽吵鬧的音樂。

tolerate.s: Modern terrorism is too destructive to be ______, much less supported.
tolerate.z: 現代恐怖主義破壞力太大，連容忍都不行，更別說支持了。

tumbled.s: Pat got so drunk that he slipped and ______ down the stairs.
tumbled.z: Pat 醉到在樓梯上滑倒，一路滾了下去。

twisted.s: When people are not able to listen, the truth gets ______. That's when trust starts to fail.
twisted.z: 人聽不進別人的話，真相就會走樣，信任也從那時候開始瓦解。

undertake.s: Regardless of the size of the project ______, our team will finish it on time and within budget.
undertake.z: 不論承接的案子規模多大，我們的團隊都會準時完成，也不會超出預算。

update.s: Google regularly sends out cars to ______ its Street View images.
update.z: Google 會定期派車出去更新街景圖片。
